Message by the Treasurer – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Message by the Treasurer LGU 2023-01-23T05:59:22+00:00 Message by the Treasurer The Treasurer is the officer managing property, finances and investments of the university and the secretary of the Finance and Planning Committee, The Treasurer’s office is a full-time position at the Lahore Garrison University. This office provides accounting , financial reporting, financial plaining to senior management ,BOG, External & Internal stakeholders ( faculty, administrative staff, and students,vendors), ensuring transparency, a timely and effective reporting system. The Treasurer’s office manages funds, assets and liabilities, income, and expenditures of the University. The Office assists the Vice-Chancellor in all financial matters. Furthermore, the office ensures transparency in pecuniary matters. The Treasurer office also handles the matters regarding student funds, scholarships, salary, and internal as well as external audit of the University. About Us – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: About Us LGU 2026-05-06T16:51:18+00:00 OUR VISION An inclusive university nurturing skilled professionals and responsible citizens. OUR MISSION To foster an open and supportive educational environment that produces graduates who can innovate as entrepreneurs and serve as responsible citizens through transformative learning, industry collaboration and a commitment to sustainability. CORE VALUES Innovation Excellence Empathy Discipline Integrity Inclusivity Attitude of Gratitude Team Building 6040 Students 1075 Courses 366 Faculty 1 Campus Message by the Vice Chancellor The long-term growth and sustainable development of nations highly depend on the professional excellence of its individuals. Human resources can perform excellently only if their capabilities are developed, continuously upgraded, and they are sufficiently motivated to work both individually and collectively for the welfare of society. This can only occur in the presence of an inclusive, vibrant, dynamic, and competitive higher education system that meets both national and international standards of excellence and practice. Universities’ contributions go beyond traditional academic roles, profoundly impacting economic, social, and environmental dimensions. Lahore Garrison University (LGU) envisions a research-driven and demand-oriented future by providing quality education to ensure a sustained supply of talented graduates with strong leadership and entrepreneurial skills. Our university takes pride in fostering strong character development grounded in ethical and moral values. The diversity and depth of our academic programs, along with the multidisciplinary nature of our applied research, inspire creative, imaginative, and innovative insights that offer solutions to real-world problems. We are committed to making a meaningful impact by heavily investing in academic, research, and innovation programs that benefit society, drive economies, promote sustainable growth, and contribute to comprehensive societal development. The faculty at LGU is highly qualified, experienced, and dedicated, consistently striving to create a student-centered learning environment through creative pedagogy. The institute features exceptional infrastructure facilities conducive to higher teaching-learning environments and research. We are committed to building strong collaborations with industry and academic institutions, both nationally and internationally, to enhance our research and innovation capacities. These efforts not only enrich the learning experience for our faculty and students but also provide opportunities for active participation in real-world projects, offering invaluable hands-on experience. I warmly invite you to join us on this thrilling voyage of education, exploration, and creativity. Maj Gen Muhammad Khalil Dar, HI(M) (Retd) LEADERSHIP Page load link Go to Top

Academic Branch’s Functions – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Academic Branch’s Functions LGU 2025-03-25T11:48:01+00:00 Functions of directorate of Academic Affairs Office: Coordinates with faculties and departments on all academic matters to ensure smooth operations. Monitors class activities through regular class inspections, ensuring effective delivery of lectures. Plans and executes Faculty Development Programs (FDPs) for faculty and associated staff to enhance professional growth. Develops and implements academic timetables in accordance with HEC criteria, ensuring proper scheduling. Updates semester rules and regulations for all academic departments to maintain quality education standards. Liaises with HEC, PHEC, HED and other government bodies to implement academic policies related to curriculum development, admission processes and enrollment regulations. Coordinates with stakeholders to formulate policies, including Admission Policy, Financial Assistance Policy, Plagiarism Policy, FDP Policy, and Timetable Policy. Facilitates university governance meetings, including Academic Council Meeting (ACM), Board of Advanced Studies and Research (BASR), Deans and HoDs to ensure structured decision-making. Supervises examination policies, grading systems, and assessment methods, maintaining transparency and academic integrity. Issues academic notifications ensuring timely documentation and compliance. Maintains academic records and curricula, aligning them with national and global education benchmarks. Organizes and supports academic events, including convocations, seminars, and workshops as per the university’s academic calendar. Ensures effective student academic support, including admissions, enrollments, transfers and graduation requirements. Drives institutional growth, research excellence, and quality education through strategic leadership and policy implementation. Supports academically weak students through remedial programs and mentorship. Monitors faculty and student performance to ensure continuous improvement. Page load link Go to Top

Achievements – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Achievements LGU 2023-06-05T04:23:00+00:00 Achiever Name Achievements Dr. Iqra Zubair Dr. Iqra Zubair spoke at the VI International Conference on Catalysis and Chemical Engineering: Dr. Iqra Zubair Awan, Assistant Professor at the Department of Chemistry, presented her research paper at the VI International Conference on Catalysis and Chemical Engineering (22-26 th February 2022), held in San Francisco, California, USA. Dr. Iqra’s research paper discussed the catalytic fractionation of biomass to obtain functional aromatic. The conference had 982 presentations and 1873 attendees from all over the world. Dr. Iqra Zubair selected to join the 71 st Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting: Dr. Iqra Zubair is one of the 6 young scientists of Pakistan who have been selected to join the 71 st Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting (to be held from 26 June – 1 st July 2022 in Lindau, Germany). She has passed the competitive selection process in which applications are evaluated by the scientific review panel of the Council for the Lindau Nobel Laureate Meetings. Dr. Iqra is among the 611 young scientists from across the world who are given the opportunity for a week of scientific exchange with around 30 Nobel Laureates in person. Page load link Go to Top

MSAI Admission Eligibility and Selection Criteria – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: MSAI Admission Eligibility and Selection Criteria LGU 2025-01-13T19:40:50+00:00 Admission Eligibility and Selection Criteria: ⦁ Basic Academic Qualification: Sixteen years of education or a BS degree in SE/CS/IT/EE/CE (4-year programme with a minimum of 120 credit hours) after HSSC/F.A./F.Sc./Grade 12 or an equivalent qualification in a relevant subject, with at least 50% marks or a minimum CGPA of 2.5 on a 4.0 scale, shall be required for admission to the MSAI programme. ⦁ Admission Test and Interview: GRE/GAT/HAT-General or University Admission Test, with a minimum cumulative score of 50%, is required for admission to the MSAI programme. The GAT test score is valid for a period of two years. Additionally, candidates must achieve at least 50% marks in the interview. ⦁ Interdisciplinary Qualification: The university may recommend 3-9 CH deficiency courses of level 6 courses, after considering the educational background and knowledge of the candidate. Deficiency courses shall be determined by the Admission Committee, before admitting the student. Page load link Go to Top

Associate Dean’s Message – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Associate Dean’s Message LGU 2024-12-31T13:04:27+00:00 Home Dean’s Message HOD’s Message Faculty Programs Offered Strategic Plan News / Events Social Media Links Alumni Policies Associate Dean’s Message Welcome to the Department of Management Sciences (DMS) at LGU, where we are dedicated to fostering student success and shaping future business leaders. Our undergraduate programs in management sciences and accounting & finance are designed to equip students with essential skills, including critical and constructive thinking, problem-solving, and exceptional communication. We also offer selective, high-quality postgraduate programs to further enhance our students’ expertise. Our vision is to provide top-tier education and research that aligns with global standards. Our strategic development plan for business education focuses on five key areas: Branding LGU, DMS : Establishing our institution as the premier choice for prospective students and employers, recognized for quality and excellence. Enhancing Education Quality : Meeting and exceeding the standards set by national and international accreditation bodies to ensure superior educational outcomes. Promoting Research Culture : Engaging students and faculty in research through our MS/Ph.D. programs, launching a research journal, and hosting national and international research conferences. Strengthening Industry-Academia Linkages : Offering well-designed executive development programs to bridge the gap between industry and academia. Inclusion of industry experts in our curriculum development committee enables us to keep curricula aligned with industry practices. Internationalization : Facilitating student mobility for entire semesters, organizing short educational visits to international universities, and providing international internship opportunities. With over 30% of our faculty holding Ph.D. degrees, DMS prides itself on excellence in teaching and innovative research publications. Our students participate in a variety of events and non-academic activities that enrich their campus experience. We also operate an active Business Incubation Center – Ibtida, which serves as a launch pad for young entrepreneurs and innovators. Ibtida aims to be a pivotal contributor to the entrepreneurial ecosystem in Pakistan. LGU supports promising ideas with seed funding of up to Rs. 1 million for each successful team incubating at BIC. Prof. Dr. Rizwana Bashir Associate Dean,Management Sciences profrizwana@lgu.edu.pk Page load link Go to Top

In case a student is unable to secure an MS within 2 years than ask for extension in duration, the university may constitute appropriate authority and determine the causes of delay. In the event of force majeure (i.e., delay on account of circumstance beyond the control of student), the university may grant an extension in the period of award of MS degree in accordance with the duration limiting factor(s) and shall also take corrective measures in case the delay is caused by process or administrative reasons. Physics is one of the most fundamental scientific disciplines, with its main goal being to understand how the universe behaves. A scientist who specializes in the field of physics is called a physicist. Objectives and Program Outcomes Program Mission: To produce competent physicists with excellent knowledge who are capable to apply practical skills in different areas of physics for employment and higher education through providing curriculum based on liberal arts education to ensure greater breadth of knowledge along with in-depth knowledge of physics by offering an opportunity to learn and experience various aspects of physics under one roof. Program Objective: The BS Physics program objectives are to: To ensure that the undergraduate education focuses not only on the main field of specialization but also provides exposure to the interdisciplinary areas of knowledge. To promote application of academic knowledge to effectively respond to real life, entrepreneurial and industry challenges and requirements. To equip students with the sense and ability to demonstrate creativity, curiosity, exploration and reflective problem solving. Program Outcomes: Organize and carry out solutions to long, complex physics problems. Function effectively both as a leader and as a member of project teams. Decide on strategies to be used and assumptions that need to be made. Determine what constitutes sufficient evidence for a conclusion. Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in multidisciplinary teams Eligibility Criteria 12 years education i.e. FSc Pre Medical or FSc Pre Engineering or ICS (Physics & Mathematics) or Equivalent Certificate. 14 years education, BSc (2 years) or ADP or Equivalent Certificate for admission in 5th semester. Biology Department HODs Message – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Biology Department HODs Message LGU 2026-05-19T09:23:14+00:00 HOD’s Message Welcome to the Department of Biology at Lahore Garrison University, where we offer a multidisciplinary approach to education, combining fields such as Microbiology, Biotechnology, and Human Nutrition & Dietetics. Our programs emphasize experiential learning and problem-solving, preparing students for successful careers in the biological sciences. We offer BS, MPhil, and Ph.D. programs designed to equip students with the skills needed to address real-world challenges in health, agriculture, and the environment. By integrating AI into our curriculum, we enhance students’ analytical abilities and ensure they stay current with emerging trends. As biology forms the foundation of many AI applications, our students gain a unique perspective on how biological principles can drive advances in artificial intelligence and data-driven research. Our faculty, including both local and foreign-qualified experts, creates an inclusive and dynamic learning environment aligned with global Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). We encourage students to explore, innovate, and contribute to solving global challenges, particularly in the fields of human nutrition and dietetics. Join us on this journey of discovery and impact. Warm regards, Dr. Hafiz Zeshan Wadood Head of the Department, Biology Lahore Garrison University Page load link Go to Top

BS CS Overview – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: BS CS Overview LGU 2025-02-03T13:04:48+00:00 BSCS – Program Educational Objectives or Program Objectives (PEOs or PO): The graduates of Computer Science program will have following capabilities/ skills / attributes four years after their graduation. 1. Comprehend the technology-oriented courses, facilitate research, promote new business ideas, and enhance computing solutions development practices. 2. Inculcate presentation and communication skills and create awareness about moral and social values. 3. Apply concepts of various subjects in integration with computing & emerging technologies. 4. Exhibit critical thinking, and problem-solving skills for advancing in higher studies. Program Learning Outcomes/Graduate Attributes (PLOs/GAs) PLOs Description PLO-1 Academic Education To prepare graduates as computing professionals. PLO-2 Knowledge for Solving Computing Problems Apply knowledge of computing fundamentals, knowledge of a computing specialization, and mathematics, science, and domain knowledge appropriate for the computing specialization to the abstraction and conceptualization of computing models from defined problems and requirements. PLO-3 Problem Analysis Identify, formulate, research literature, and solve complex computing problems reaching substantiated conclusions using fundamental principles of mathematics, computing sciences, and relevant domain disciplines. PLO-4 Design / Development of Solutions Design and evaluate solutions for complex computing problems, and design and evaluate systems, components, or processes that meet specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, cultural, societal, and environmental considerations. PLO-5 Modern Tool Usage Create, select, adapt, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern computing tools to complex computing activities, with an understanding of the limitations. PLO-6 Individual and Teamwork Function effectively as an individual and as a member or leader in diverse teams and in multi-disciplinary settings. PLO-7 Communication Communicate effectively with the computing community and with society at large about complex computing activities by being able to comprehend and write effective reports, design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and understand clear instructions. PLO-8 Computing Professionalism and Society Understand and assess societal, health, safety, legal, and cultural issues within local and global contexts, and the consequential responsibilities relevant to professional computing practice. PLO-9 Ethics Understand and commit to professional ethics, responsibilities, and norms of professional computing practice. PLO-10 Lifelong Learning Recognize the need, and have the ability, to engage in independent learning for continual development as a computing professional. University’s Vision PEO-1 PEO-2 PEO-3 PEO-4 To be a renowned University in Teaching, Research, Innovation, and Commercialization , providing a conducive environment for the acquisition of latest knowledge so that students may contribute to community support, technical and socioeconomic development. ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ University’s Mission PEO-1 PEO-2 PEO-3 PEO-4 To play a leading role in technical and socioeconomic development through academic and research excellence while adhering to international quality standards. BS WCCI (Hons) 4 Years – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: BS WCCI (Hons) 4 Years LGU 2022-08-17T09:17:47+00:00 BS in White Collar Crime Investigation Programme Overview Fighting Corruption is among the most important priorities among any developing nation. This degree programme focuses on providing hands on experience to the graduates to focus on investigation and mitigating the risk of fraud in public and private organizations. After the completion of this degree programme, the graduates will be able to investigate white collar crimes. Programme Objectives To prepare Fraud Investigators keep in view the requirements of the existing stakeholders, agencies, and industry who can contribute towards decreasing corruption by using technology to conduct rapid and effective fraud investigation. To educate students keeping in view the requirements of the existing stakeholder, agencies, and industry to investigate white-collar crimes and decrease corruption. To create awareness about the emerging technologies used in investigating white collar crimes. To develop strong ethical values among the students so they can use them in the workplace. Develop understanding among students concerning core areas of white collar crimes, corruption and anti-corruption, anti-money laundering and counter financing of terrorism. To develop strong communication skills with due emphasis on technical report writing skills which are required for corporate sector investigation and public sector investigation. Program Learning Outcomes Students shall be able to utilize the core concept of white-collar crime investigation, digital forensics, anti-money laundering and counter financing for terrorism in the field. Apply fundamental concepts of investigation such as pre- investigation requirement fulfilment, following investigation protocols, and delivering the outcomes of the findings to the stakeholders. Apply the fundamental white collar crimes, corruption and anti-corruption, anti-money laundering and counter financing of terrorism.. Identification of the vulnerabilities and loopholes within the organizational policies, and procedures related to traditional as well as the computational system, conducting gap analysis, and developing fraud mitigation strategies. Students will have in-depth knowledge about the use of tools and techniques which are used for solving crimes. Students will use the modern tools available in the market for analysing digital evidence and articulating results based on the analysis drawn using the tools. Must be able to utilize the tools to conduct digital forensic analysis. Must be able to understand the hardware and software architecture of computer systems and be able to explain the function and interaction of computer processing units, memories, and input/output devices. Students will be eligible to define and explain the important elements involved in post incident investigations and recovery plans. The students will have the related knowledge of the laws applicable to digital evidence and related investigations. BTECH HND Overview – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: BTECH HND Overview LGU 2025-02-03T12:32:25+00:00 Programme Overview and Scope: The Higher National Diploma (HND) in Computing, awarded by Pearson, is a highly regarded qualification that provides students with the essential skills and knowledge required to succeed in the ever-evolving field of computing. The programme is designed to equip students with a broad understanding of computing technologies, methodologies, and practices, making them highly employable in various industries such as software development, IT support, system administration, and more. The HND in Computing at Lahore Garrison University (LGU) offers a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical skills. The curriculum focuses on key areas like software development, network systems, databases, cybersecurity, and business information systems. Students will have access to state-of-the-art facilities, expert faculty, and resources that foster a dynamic learning environment. Upon completion of the HND in Computing, graduates have the flexibility to either enter the workforce directly or progress to higher education, such as a bachelor’s degree, through LGU’s established pathways or through international university partnerships. Programme Objectives: To Develop Core Computing Skills: Equip students with a solid foundation in computing principles, programming, system design, and network management. To Prepare for Industry Demands: Provide students with the practical skills and knowledge needed for a range of roles in IT and computing industries. To Foster Problem-Solving Abilities: Encourage critical thinking and problem-solving skills through project-based learning and real-world scenarios. To Ensure Professional Development: Prepare students for professional certification exams and future learning, helping them stay competitive in the fast-paced tech industry. To Promote Ethical and Sustainable Practices: Educate students about the ethical issues, data security, and sustainability challenges in the computing industry. Learning Outcomes: Upon successful completion of the HND in Computing, students will be able to: Demonstrate Technical Competence: Show proficiency in key areas of computing such as programming, software development, database management, and network systems. Apply Problem-Solving Techniques: Identify and analyze problems in computing systems, applying logical and innovative solutions. Work Effectively in Teams: Collaborate with peers and professionals to deliver projects in diverse and multidisciplinary teams. Communicate Professionally: Convey technical concepts clearly and professionally, both orally and in writing, to a range of audiences. Evaluate Computing Solutions: Assess existing computing solutions and recommend improvements or innovations to enhance performance, security, and scalability. Understand the Professional Environment: Comprehend the ethical, legal, and societal issues within the computing field, including the importance of data security and privacy. Develop Continuous Learning Habits: Be equipped with the skills and attitude to engage in continuous professional development and adapt to new technologies. Page load link Go to Top

Certificate in Urdu for Foreign Students(CERUF) – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Certificate in Urdu for Foreign Students(CERUF) LGU 2024-12-05T04:39:42+00:00 Certificate in Urdu for Foreign Students(CERUF) Certificate in Urdu for Foreign Students(CERUF) Course Duration: 6 Months Total Credit Hours: 06 Semester: 1 Apply Now Fee Structure Objectives: The main objectives of CERUF program are: To develop foundational skills in reading, writing, speaking, and understanding Urdu for effective communication. To introduce students to the rich cultural and literary heritage of Urdu-speaking communities. To foster cross-cultural understanding and appreciation through the study of Urdu language and traditions. To prepare students to use Urdu in real-life contexts, such as travel, social interaction, or professional engagement in Urdu-speaking regions. Outcomes: The outcomes of CERUF program include: Students will be able to engage in simple conversations, understand basic written texts, and express themselves in Urdu, both in speaking and writing. Students will gain exposure to key aspects of Urdu literature, poetry, and cultural practices, enriching their understanding of the social and historical context of the language. Students will develop the ability to interact with Urdu speakers with confidence, demonstrating respect for and understanding of cultural nuances. Students will be able to use Urdu effectively in daily interactions, travel, and professional settings, applying their language skills in real-world contexts. Computer Science PLO’s – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Computer Science PLO’s LGU 2024-04-15T05:26:13+00:00 Program Learning Outcomes (PLO’s): PLOs Description PLO-1 Academic Education To prepare graduates as computing professionals. PLO-2 Knowledge for Solving Computing Problems Apply knowledge of computing fundamentals, knowledge of a computing specialization, and mathematics, science, and domain knowledge appropriate for the computing specialization to the 16 abstraction and conceptualization of computing models from defined problems and requirements. PLO-3 Problem Analysis Identify, formulate, research literature, and solve complex computing problems reaching substantiated conclusions using fundamental principles of mathematics, computing sciences, and relevant domain disciplines. PLO-4 Design / Development of Solutions Design and evaluate solutions for complex computing problems, and design and evaluate systems, components, or processes that meet specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, cultural, societal, and environmental considerations. PLO-5 Modern Tool Usage Create, select, adapt, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern computing tools to complex computing activities, with an understanding of the limitations. PLO-6 Individual and Teamwork Function effectively as an individual and as a member or leader in diverse teams and in multi-disciplinary settings. PLO-7 Communication Communicate effectively with the computing community and with society at large about complex computing activities by being able to comprehend and write effective reports, design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and understand clear instructions. PLO-8 Computing Professionalism and Society Understand and assess societal, health, safety, legal, and cultural issues within local and global contexts, and the consequential responsibilities relevant to professional computing practice. PLO-9 Ethics Understand and commit to professional ethics, responsibilities, and norms of professional computing practice. PLO-10 Lifelong Learning Recognize the need, and have the ability, to engage in independent learning for continual development as a computing professional. Core Values Department of Mathematics – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Core Values Department of Mathematics LGU 2022-05-16T07:18:23+00:00 Core Values First and foremost, the Department of Mathematics supports a varied and multicultural learning community that actively participates in fostering the ideas of the liberal arts of critical thinking and lifelong learning to carry out the university’s values. We regard teaching and learning as our greatest priority, while also embracing the value of scholarship and service, to effectively promote these ideals. As a result, we appreciate and encourage a variety of instructional perspectives and approaches, including but not limited to: Faculty who are well-informed and competent, as well as introspective and evolving as educators. Innovations in teaching that demonstrate a learning-centered approach to instruction. Active involvement of students in their learning. Developing a community of learners among students and faculty. Broadly defined professional activities that include but are not limited to. Keeping up with the latest developments in mathematics and mathematics education, as well as contributing to their advancement. Using mathematics to solve problems in a range of situations. Centred exploration in the instructing and learning of science at all levels. Community-oriented exploration with peers and with understudies. Interdisciplinary scholarship. Service activities that include but are not limited to Dynamic interest in accomplishing division, school, and college objectives. Cooperation with industry, schools, and local gatherings. Advancing the calling at the nearby, provincial, and public levels. In every one of these spaces, we additionally esteem kept coaching of all Mathematics Department workforce and staff. Note that the foremost item in our mission, vision and values statements relates to teaching and student learning. As we map our strategic plan, that frames and directs all of our actions. The ultimate priority of the Department of Mathematics is to provide the best possible learning environment and instruction for our students. To meet our mission, vision, and values, the Department of Mathematics faces many short and long-term challenges. Among these are: Providing high-quality instruction and class sizes that allow for student-centered learning and effective student/faculty interaction in the face of increasing enrollments and insufficient numbers of tenure-line faculty; Diversifying our faculty to provide a variety of viewpoints and ideas and to better reflect our student body and the world around us; Assuring appropriate opportunities and resources for faculty and students to engage in relevant scholarly activities; Developing and sustaining programs that meet the needs of our students and community. Criminology Overview – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Criminology Overview LGU 2023-07-11T11:32:52+00:00 Introduction The BS (4-Year) Programme in Criminology has been designed to disseminate a blend of theoretical and practical knowledge needed to understand crime, criminal behavior and criminality. It is an interdisciplinary programme comprising 127 credit hours to be completed in eight semesters. Apart from general and elective courses, the programme consists of nine foundation courses, twelve major courses including internship and thesis/ research project. This programme is developed to provide the young graduates with job-oriented skills to augment employability and producing young professionals to re-shape the policies to prevent crime in Pakistan in general. The major objective of this programme is to provide the students with hands- on-training in the specialized fields of criminology such as forensic criminology, criminal and juvenile justice systems, criminal investigation, geographic crime analysis, crime mapping and security related issues through its extensive internship programme. Special focus has been given on developing research skills. Students are required to carry out research projects/thesis to uncover the major issues related to the field of criminology. Mission statement Transformation of social, political and economic structures in the wake of globalization has resulted in various challenges including increasing incidence of crime and violence. Scientific understanding is needed to deal with such issues. Realizing the need of emerging discipline of criminology, Higher Education Commission (HEC) has taken the initiative to launch BS (4- Years) Programme in Criminology. This programme will help to develop the understanding of young graduates about theoretical and practical knowledge of crime and deviance in Pakistan. The programme will develop analytical skills of the students to tone down criminality in Pakistan. Page load link Go to Top

CS HOD’s Message – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: CS HOD’s Message LGU 2022-09-12T04:15:26+00:00 HOD’s Message It is my pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Computer Science at Lahore Garrison University, which is the largest department in terms of students and faculty, with expertise across the discipline. We offer an NCEAC-accredited Bachelors program in Computer Science that has gone on to produce graduates who have had great success in industry and academia. Our growing MS program provides advanced coursework and research in areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Information Security, Digital Image Processing, Cloud Computing, Distributed Computing, Blockchain and Advanced Databases. Together, these programs offer our students at all levels the opportunity to engage in research, experiential learning, and depth of study within the discipline, alongside dedicated faculty and a strong team of student-centered advisors and staff. We strive to provide ample opportunities for research, industry experience, and professional development alongside academic leaders and industry innovators with years of dedicated experience in both traditional and modern high-tech fields. It is our commitment to offer a diverse and interactive learning space with up-to-date curricula that keeps pace with current developments in technology. We are eager for you to get started on your journey at LGU and hope that you consider joining us as part of one of our CS programs. Dr. Arfan Ali Nagra Head of Department Computer Science Department Page load link Go to Top

Dr. Kausar Sohail, a Clinical Psychologist currently living in Canada gave an influential online lecture on “Stress, Awareness, and Coping Strategies”. In her lecture, she described that stress is any type of change that causes physical, psychological, or emotional strain. It is very important that one learns and recognizes when they are experiencing stress, as this is the first step to combat stress. Stress can further be managed by problem-focused coping, emotion focused coping, and social support. Problem-focused coping is all the active efforts we put in to manage stressful situations and alter our troubled environment and relationships to modify or eliminate the sources of stress via individual behavior. Emotion focused coping includes talking, and writing about the emotions through therapy, mindful meditation, or distraction with other activities. Social support is getting help from friends and family in times of crisis to give us a broader focus and positive self-image. The lecture streamed online via Zoom and LGU TV and aired in Lahore Garrison University where it was attended by all students, faculty members and the Chairperson of the Psychology department. UMT Conference 9th -10th March, 2017 Institute of Clinical Psychology of University of Management and Technology conducted “1st International conference, Clinical Psychology in the Developing World” on 9-10th March, 2017”. Students of Department of Psychology, LGU, presented their research paper in this conference. From MSC Applied Psychology Rabia Rashid, supervised by Ms.Uzma Ilyas, and Iram Javed, supervised by Ms. Saira Maqsood participated in oral presentations. From MS Clinical Psychology, Fatima Salman participated in oral presentation. The students from LGU were awarded with the certificates for participation. Modern Trends in Psychology 1. University of Sargodha, Gujranwala Campus held research conference on 27th August, 2016 with title “Modern Trends in Psychology”. 2. There were total 26 papers presented and LGU contributed by presenting eight papers. There were conducted under supervision of Ms. Uzma Ilyas, Ms. Nida Zafar and Ms. Saira Maqsood. 3. Muhammad Mohsin, student of M.Sc II (Applied Psychology) scored first position. Topic of his presentation was “Poor Eating Habits, Executive Functioning and Mental & Physical Health in University Students”. 4. The participants were from different institutions i.e. Lahore Garrison University, University of Sargodha, University of Gujrat and Soft Solution College. The conference was held under the collaboration of University of Sargodha and Soft Solution College, Gujranwala. In conference informal quiz was conducted and three out of five questions were answered by Lahore Garrison University Students and won prizes for that too. On a whole it promoted to research culture in Applied Psychology Department. 5. All the details about this conference have been updated to English Department for Newsletter and to CS for updating website. Students’ Achievement in Mental Health Competition at UCP 1. Students from Psychology Department LGU, participated in a Mental Health Week entitled, “Taboo-Defacing Gender” from 24th – 25th November, 2016 organized by University of Central Punjab. The participants from Lahore Garrison University, University of The Punjab, University of Management and Technology and Government College University, Lahore took part in the event. 2. It was three day event organized by UCP. Overall, posters from five universities were presented on 24th November 2016. UMT secured 1st position whereas Lahore Garrison University secured runner up status. 3. The third and last day competition of performing arts was held. Along with LGU, other universities showed their talents in it by enacting short dramas and skits on the punching taboos of today. 4. LGU Applied Psychology students, opted the genre of mime. In 13 minutes mime, students highlighted four main taboos of our society including Divorce, Honor Killing, Transgender and Prostitution. The idea was not only unique from others but it was highly appreciated by the audience. 5. The University of the Punjab secured 1st position in performing arts competition, whereas Lahore Garrison University, was runner up in it. 6. Collectively, this event has bequeathed an innovative experience to LGU students in the abstract expression of cognition and emotion regarding current taboos of society and suggesting solution to them. The respected guest speaker highlighted the assessment and management of stress levels. The techniques were mentioned in depth for intervening stress and strategies were discussed along with its demonstration. Mr. Kaukab Jamal Zuberi Associate Dean Read More! × Mr. Kaukab Jamal Zuberi Qualification: Associate Dean Kaukab Jamal Zuberi is a prominent figure in the field of digital forensics and cyber security in Pakistan. He serves as the Associate Dean of the Department of Criminology and Forensic Sciences at Lahore Garrison University (LGU) and is the Director of the university’s Digital Forensic Research and Service Centre (DFRSC). In 2016, Zuberi led the establishment of the DFRSC at LGU, marking it as the first center of its kind in Pakistan. The center focuses on research, training, certification, and degree programs in various fields of digital forensics and cyber security. This center is pioneering efforts to address the growing need for cybersecurity and digital forensics in Pakistan, focusing on training professionals and conducting research to enhance the nation’s cyber capabilities. He aims to prepare experts who can navigate the complexities of digital security in both public and private sectors. Beyond his academic roles, Zuberi is the founding chairman of the International Association of Digital Forensic Experts (IADFE). Zuberi has also contributed to discussions on cyber security challenges in Pakistan, highlighting issues such as phone scams, data leaks, and the need for robust data protection laws. He has been actively involved in discussions surrounding critical infrastructure in Pakistan, emphasizing the importance of robust cybersecurity measures to protect national interests. His work includes publishing articles that advocate for better regulatory frameworks in these areas. As the Head of Department, I am honored to lead a team of distinguished faculty and staff who share a passion for advancing the understanding of crime and justice. Our department offers a comprehensive range of programs, Our curricula are carefully crafted to equip students with the theoretical knowledge, practical skills, and critical thinking abilities necessary to succeed in their chosen careers. Our department is also well known for its certifications and trainings of digital and forensics. We take pride in our state-of-the-art facilities, cutting-edge research initiatives, and strong industry partnerships. Our faculty members are renowned experts in their fields, with a strong commitment to teaching, research, and community service. As we continue to navigate the complexities of the modern world, the importance of criminology cannot be overstated. Our department is dedicated to producing highly skilled professionals who can make a meaningful difference in the pursuit of justice and the promotion of community safety. Thank you for your interest in the Department of Criminology. I look forward to welcoming you to our community of scholars and professionals. Sincerely, Dr. Kausar Parveen H.O.D. DFRSC Home – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: DFRSC Home LGU 2025-04-22T12:01:18+00:00 Overview Digital Forensics Research and Service Centre (DFRSC) was established in June 2016 as Centre of studies for Digital Forensic and Cyber Crime Investigations at Lahore Garrison University. LGU has made a remarkable impact on the canvas of Digital Forensics and related technologies in last six years. Due to increased demand for our degree programme and keeping in view the emerging trend in the market, a need is recognized to create a new department – “Department of Criminology”. This department will expand the existing faculty, enhance the scope of studies and will offer various new degree programmes to cater the growing demand for quality education in criminology. Department Vision To become a leading education provider in the fields of criminology, serving the community, preparing competitive graduates, who can help in decreasing crimes in the society and to take its degree programmes to international market. Department Mission Achieve excellence in teaching and research by incorporating the emerging technologies through effective stakeholders’ engagement and to prepare self-driven and competitive graduates. Diploma in Urdu as Official Language (OLUD) – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Diploma in Urdu as Official Language (OLUD) LGU 2024-12-05T05:34:13+00:00 Diploma in Urdu as Official Language (OLUD) Diploma in Urdu as Official Language (OLUD) Course Duration: 06 Months Total Credit Hours: 09 Semester: 1 Apply Now Fee Structure Objectives: The main objectives of OLUD program are: To develop students’ ability to effectively use Urdu in official settings, including government, legal, and administrative contexts. To equip students with knowledge of specialized vocabulary, terms, and expressions commonly used in official Urdu documents, reports, and correspondence. To prepare students for roles that promote the use and standardization of Urdu as an official language in public institutions, media, and policy-making. To foster an understanding of how Urdu can be used to preserve cultural heritage while fulfilling its role as a modern official language in diverse sectors. Outcomes: The outcomes of OLUD program include: Students will be able to confidently use Urdu in professional and administrative contexts, including writing reports, letters, and other official documents. Students will gain proficiency in the specialized vocabulary and terminology used in governmental, legal, and administrative settings, enhancing their ability to navigate official language requirements. Students will be equipped to play an active role in promoting and standardizing Urdu in official communications and governance. Students will develop the skills to advocate for the use and preservation of Urdu in public life, contributing to its continued relevance as an official language. Diploma in Urdu Literature for Foreign Students (DULLFS) – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Diploma in Urdu Literature for Foreign Students (DULLFS) LGU 2024-12-05T05:12:28+00:00 Diploma in Urdu Literature for Foreign Students (DULLFS) Diploma in Urdu Literature for Foreign Students (DULLFS) Course Duration: 1 Years Total Credit Hours: 24 Semester: 2 Apply Now Fee Structure Objectives: The main objectives of DULLFS program are: To provide students with a comprehensive understanding of classical and modern Urdu literature, including poetry, prose, and major literary movements. To introduce students to the historical, cultural, and socio-political influences that have shaped Urdu literature and its evolution over time. To develop students’ ability to critically analyze Urdu literary works, fostering an appreciation for their thematic, stylistic, and linguistic elements. To enhance students’ understanding of Urdu’s significance in the global literary landscape and its role in fostering cross-cultural dialogue. Outcomes: The outcomes ofDULLFS program include: Students will gain a deep knowledge of key works and genres in classical and modern Urdu literature, enhancing their literary appreciation. Students will develop a strong understanding of the cultural and historical contexts that have influenced the evolution of Urdu literature, connecting it with broader global literary traditions. Students will acquire the ability to critically analyze and interpret Urdu literary texts, recognizing their thematic, linguistic, and artistic significance. Students will be equipped to engage with Urdu literature in a global context, promoting intercultural exchange and understanding of Urdu’s role in world literature. Through proactive leadership, strategic planning and unwavering dedication, we continue to shape LGU into a distinguished directorate of higher education and intellectual advancement. Directorate SA&C – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Directorate SA&C LGU 2021-04-14T08:54:46+00:00 Directorate SA&C Overview The Student Affairs Office serves as a liaison between students, faculty and administration. The primary function of Student Affairs Office is to be of assistance to students in any way possible. It leads, directs, and administers overall functions of student counseling, hostel residence, student societies and discipline. The important function of Student Affairs Office is to enhance the quality of student life both in and outside of the classroom. Overseen by Dean Student Affairs, this office is a central place for students where they can express and get help about any problem, they encounter on campus whether it is academic, personal or emotional. The Student Affairs Office has a full-time Assistant Director Student Affairs, who is readily available to students for sorting out problems. The students are encouraged to have recourse to him for counseling and guidance. Efforts are made to ensure a student life, free from worries and distractions, to help them learn to manage their affairs on their own and to cope with strains and stresses which are part of the growth processes. The Student Affairs Office functions as a friend and guide of a student, it administers his needs from the time he steps in the Institute for admission, to the time he graduates from the Institute. It provides forums for cultivation of literary and artistic potentialities and furnishes them healthy outlets in sports and games, which make their stay on campus, a rich experience of multi-dimensional growth. The student Affairs Office provides proactive support and capacity building services to promote co- curricular activities in the Institute which could enrich our graduates at every stage of their life as well as they could build strong relationships with their peers, faculty, administration and other stakeholders. Career Development Office Directorate of Student Affair and Counselling and External Relations at LGU, with the collaboration of Rozee.pk, has developed a Career Portal for students and alumni. The portal provides listings of recent jobs related to disciplines offered at LGU. Students and alumni can sign up with their University Registration numbers to become a member and to apply for current vacancies. At Lahore Garrison University (LGU), we are fully conscious of the utility of earning practical experience for students by undergoing internship(s) during their studies. Interning in a field of choice will stand out on students’ resume and help them with their job search after graduation. Students/interns should endeavor to gain on-the-job training that integrates education and career development, while organizations and companies hosting interns also benefitted from the contributions of creative and innovative students. People/Students meet during their internship become subsequently professional “contacts” who can help guide their career path as they make their way into professional world. The office mainly serves the following purposes: The office is used for advising the students Information on various companies is available from the Careers Office The office serves as a bridge between the perspective employers and students The office helps the students in the preparation of their CV The office helps in finding internships for the students Student Counselling Service The Office of Student Affairs promotes a sense of community and belongingness among students, and through our efforts we convey the message to students that they are not alone in times of stress. The student counselor works regularly with students to help them in their emotional, psychological, familial, and academic problems. Stress management techniques and relaxation methods are offered to deal with anxiety and stress. We assure the students the complete confidentiality of their discussions. Page load link Go to Top

Dr. Gulzar Ahmad Profile – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Dr. Gulzar Ahmad Profile LGU 2021-04-28T09:57:17+00:00 Dr. GULZAR AHMAD (PhD) Professor & Head Department of Psychology Lahore Garrison University, Ave. 4, Sector C, DHA-6, Lahore Pakistan. Tel: (+92) 0302 4884883 / (+92) 0333 4321989 Email: drgulzar@lgu.edu. pk / gulzar818@gmail.com Excellence Awarded College & University Professor with National & Global exposure and diversified experience of teaching, corporate & Soft skills training , Counseling and research in Applied Psychology, Education, Business Management & Leadership Studies. Motivated, Energetic, Visionary for excellence in education, Research, Training & Innovation. Dr. Gulzar Ahmad is Professor and Head, Department of Psychology at Lahore Garrison University, Lahore. He is a researcher, corporate soft skills trainer and counseling psychologist. He qualified his PhD in Applied Psychology in 1998 from University of the Punjab, Lahore that was evaluated as equivalent to regionally accredited universities in US by the IERF, NACES, Inc., US. On the invitations of many governmental and non-governmental organizations in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, Africa and Australia, Dr. Gulzar participated in over 100 national and international conferences and workshops. His over 20 research papers have been published in journals of national and international repute. Some of his researches are quoted in UN and World Bank publications. He has supervised over 80 research thesis of BS, MS, MPhil, MBA scholars. Dr. Gulzar was honored as an HEC Foreign Professor by the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan and the Kingdom of Bahrain. Most of his teaching tenure was at GCU Lahore, GSC Lahore, UOG, Gujrat, LLU, Lahore in Pakistan and some high ranking internationally affiliated universities in Bahrain. He was honored with excellent teaching awards by FBE, and the best speaker awards by the Toastmaster International Club, Bahrain. In addition to teaching different subjects of Psychology, Education, Organizational Management & Leadership streams in Pakistan and abroad, he is the chief editor of Journal of Applied & Clinical Psychology and editorial /review Board member of over 10 national and international research journals. Additionally, he was the Secretary HEC National Curriculum Review Committee for graduate and post-graduate Psychology degree programs. Dr. Gulzar is also the President of Pakistan Council on Family Relations . Additionally, he is certified Holistic health Counselor from US and provides psychological counseling in all areas of life especially, adolescence, work, marriage and family. He is a renowned writer for the community’s social and moral development, public speaker, and his over 100 interviews/news items were printed in national and international media, broadcast and telecast on many states and private radio and television channels including PBC, VOA, PTV network, Bahrain radio & television, ABC radio & television South Africa and ABC radio & television Australia. Dr. Gulzar has/had been holding memberships and positions in over 40 national and international organizations around the globe. His biography is published in Marquis Who’s Who in the World, New Jersey, US and International Biographical Centre, Cambridge, England, UK in 12 consecutive editions each. He loves innovation, beauty and morality, and aspires for peace, progress and excellent human development. Page load link Go to Top

English Department HODs Message – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: English Department HODs Message LGU 2026-06-15T09:14:48+00:00 HOD’s Message Our mission is to take a leading role in the region to prepare our students to be critical readers and thinkers through developing their analytical abilities and appreciation of the literary and linguistic productions of their own culture and those of other cultures and communities. As a team, we make a vibrant academic community which is fully poised to expand its students’ linguistic and literary horizons. This is achieved through lectures, workshops, seminars and faculty-student interaction. Our instructors motivate the students to tailor their individual understanding of language and literature and facilitate them in responding to their academic and pre-professional needs. Similarly, we invite notable authors and scholars for their insightful lectures and readings. We boast that our students, upon graduation, leave us having extensive theoretical knowledge about English language and literature. As for our research-based programmes, these are designed to equip our students with skills in independent inquiry, critical thinking, valuable interlocution, originality – all that is needed for conducting invaluable academic research. We also boast our state-of-the-art facilities which include a well-stocked university library, fully equipped computer labs, online research databases, as well as printing and scanning facilities. We are very keen to contribute in the actualization of the vision and mission of Lahore Garrison University (LGU) through various academic programmes and research activities. LGU English Department is committed to produce better individuals to build our nation. I am looking forward to seeing you at the Department of English Language and Literature and wish all our students and graduates continued growth and success in their educational and professional endeavors. Mr. Qasim Ali HOD English Department Page load link Go to Top

H&A HOD’s Message – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: H&A HOD’s Message LGU 2026-03-18T06:37:18+00:00 HOD’s Message It is my privilege to welcome you to the Department of Humanities and Arts at Lahore Garrison University—an academic platform dedicated to fostering intellectual growth through interdisciplinary engagement and humanistic inquiry. The department was established with a clear vision: to integrate diverse disciplines and create a dynamic academic environment that responds to the evolving needs of contemporary education. By bringing together the fields of International Relations & Political Science, Islamic Studies, and Urdu, we have cultivated a space that values both tradition and innovation. At present, the department continues to uphold its academic commitments through ongoing programs, including PhD and MPhil degrees in Islamic Studies and Urdu, as well as undergraduate semesters in International Relations. These programs reflect our longstanding dedication to academic excellence and scholarly development. As we move forward, the department is undergoing a strategic academic transition. While current cohorts are being supported to successful completion of their degrees, future admissions in these standalone programs have been concluded. This step marks an intentional shift toward strengthening our role as a fully interdisciplinary department within the university. In this capacity, we proudly serve as a central academic resource, offering a wide array of allied and interdisciplinary courses across multiple faculties. Our curriculum spans areas such as Quranic Studies, Pakistan Studies, International Relations and Current Affairs, World History, Philosophy, Global Governance, Public Policy, Blue Economy, Emerging and Disruptive Technologies, and Comparative Foreign Policies of Great Powers. Through these offerings, we aim to equip students with critical thinking skills, ethical awareness, and a comprehensive understanding of both local and global challenges. Our focus is not only on imparting knowledge but also on nurturing well-rounded individuals who can contribute meaningfully to society. The Department of Humanities and Arts remains committed to academic innovation, collaboration, and excellence as it evolves into a cornerstone of interdisciplinary education at Lahore Garrison University. I invite you to explore our programs and initiatives and be a part of this transformative academic journey. Dr. Kanwal Hayat Chairperson Department of Humanities and Arts Page load link Go to Top

HOD Message Chemistry – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: HOD Message Chemistry LGU 2025-07-07T22:37:06+00:00 HOD’s Message Welcome to the Department of Chemistry at Lahore Garrison University! The Department of Chemistry, at Lahore Garrison University is known for its center for cutting-edge research and academic excellence, where our experienced faculty mentor students through rigorous instruction and groundbreaking research. From traditional subfields such as biochemistry, organic, inorganic, and physical chemistry to interdisciplinary and theoretical research, we provide a strong framework that prepares students for leadership in science and industry. At LGU, we are proud to announce the launch of a new undergraduate degree program, BS Computational Chemistry with Artificial Intelligence. This program is designed to meet the demands of the modern era, where AI and computational tools are revolutionizing industries, including pharmaceuticals, materials science, environmental sciences, and energy. Computational chemistry, combined with AI, enables scientists to predict molecular behavior, accelerate drug discovery, optimize industrial processes, and develop sustainable solutions for global challenges. Graduates of this program will be equipped with cutting-edge skills in molecular modeling, machine learning, and advanced computational techniques, making them highly sought after in industries such as drug design, chemical manufacturing, AI-driven research, and beyond. The program also opens pathways to dynamic careers in academia and research institutions worldwide. Chairperson Department of Chemistry Dr. Sadaf Sarfraz Page load link Go to Top

HOD Message of Mathematics Department – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: HOD Message of Mathematics Department LGU 2026-02-14T07:15:49+00:00 DEPARTMENT OF MATHEMATICS HOD Message The significance of Mathematics is due to its increasing demand in stages with new advancements in engineering and science. The challenges of keeping up to date are absolutely essential. We are living in an era where the digital system has become an integral part of our daily lives. Apart from imagination and speculation, one cannot understand concepts in Engineering Science, Physics, Computer Science, Management Science, and Social Science without Mathematics. Lahore Garrison University’s Mathematics department is dedicated to providing quality instructional services to all other departments. The department offers a BS Mathematics, BS Industrial Mathematics, M.Phil Mathematics and PhD Mathematics programs. Our professors are dedicated to providing high-quality instruction in conceptual areas. Aside from the many Mathematics degrees, the department also provides a solid scientific and mathematical foundation to undergraduate professionals in all of the university’s other departments. Beyond degrees, the department plays a pivotal role in providing a robust scientific and mathematical foundation to undergraduate professionals across all university departments. Actively engaged in pure, applied, and computational mathematics, our faculty significantly contributes to advancing the frontiers of mathematical knowledge, fostering international collaboration. Throughout the academic calendar, we host seminars, conferences, and workshops, fostering intellectual discourse. Guided by a commitment to excellence, I invite you to explore the limitless possibilities Mathematics offers, unraveling the mysteries of the universe and driving innovation. IBTIDA-Business Incubation Centre – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: IBTIDA-Business Incubation Centre LGU 2025-12-15T11:38:27+00:00 IBTIDA – Business Incubation Centre Welcome to IBTIDA IBTIDA , the Business Incubation Centre of Lahore Garrison University, is where innovation meets entrepreneurship. We are committed to nurturing creative minds and transforming groundbreaking ideas into thriving business ventures. Our mission is to empower students and aspiring entrepreneurs by providing them with the resources, opportunities, and mentorship they need to develop successful business ventures. ITICS – 2022 – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content ITICS – 2022 LGU 2023-03-28T05:00:37+00:00   ABOUT CONFERENCE 1st International Conference on IT Infrastructure and Computational security2022 (ITICS-2022)International Conference on IT Infrastructure and computational security (ITICS-2022) has been organized by faculty of IT Department, Lahore Garrison University, Lahore, Pakistan. IT security is a multi-discipline subject requiring a number of different skills sets and knowledge areas. A key area of knowledge which is vital for any security specialist is a clear understanding of IT infrastructure and how it relates to the creation of a comprehensive security strategy. The purpose of this conference is to look at the various components that comprise the IT infrastructure of an organization. Some of these components are specifically designed to provide security (such as firewalls), whilst others are simply necessary to fulfill the needs of an IT operation (such as routers and switches). The 1st International Conference on IT Infrastructure and computational security (ITICS-2022) will be held at Lahore Garrison University, Lahore, on 26 – 27 April 2023. The conference is giving an opportunity to the presenters to the present in hybrid mode, that can be physically or remotely using online mode of presentation. OUR MISSION To foster an open and supportive educational environment that produces graduates who can innovate as entrepreneurs and serve as responsible citizens through transformative learning, industry collaboration and a commitment to sustainability. CORE VALUES Innovation Excellence Empathy Discipline Integrity Inclusivity Attitude of Gratitude Team Building 6040 Students 1075 Courses 366 Faculty 1 Campus Message by the Vice Chancellor The long-term growth and sustainable development of nations highly depend on the professional excellence of its individuals. Human resources can perform excellently only if their capabilities are developed, continuously upgraded, and they are sufficiently motivated to work both individually and collectively for the welfare of society. This can only occur in the presence of an inclusive, vibrant, dynamic, and competitive higher education system that meets both national and international standards of excellence and practice. Universities’ contributions go beyond traditional academic roles, profoundly impacting economic, social, and environmental dimensions. Lahore Garrison University (LGU) envisions a research-driven and demand-oriented future by providing quality education to ensure a sustained supply of talented graduates with strong leadership and entrepreneurial skills. Our university takes pride in fostering strong character development grounded in ethical and moral values. The diversity and depth of our academic programs, along with the multidisciplinary nature of our applied research, inspire creative, imaginative, and innovative insights that offer solutions to real-world problems. We are committed to making a meaningful impact by heavily investing in academic, research, and innovation programs that benefit society, drive economies, promote sustainable growth, and contribute to comprehensive societal development. The faculty at LGU is highly qualified, experienced, and dedicated, consistently striving to create a student-centered learning environment through creative pedagogy. The institute features exceptional infrastructure facilities conducive to higher teaching-learning environments and research. We are committed to building strong collaborations with industry and academic institutions, both nationally and internationally, to enhance our research and innovation capacities. These efforts not only enrich the learning experience for our faculty and students but also provide opportunities for active participation in real-world projects, offering invaluable hands-on experience. I warmly invite you to join us on this thrilling voyage of education, exploration, and creativity. Maj Gen Muhammad Khalil Dar, HI(M) (Retd) LEADERSHIP Page load link Go to Top

Phil Biotechnology Objectives: The main objectives of M. Phil Biotechnology degree program are: To equip the students with a comprehensive understanding of contemporary knowledge and methodologies in the field of Biotechnology, also empowering them to conduct applied research and generate scholarly publications. To develop knowledgeable scholars in biotechnology, well-versed in the latest trends and advancements in scientific research within the field of biological sciences. To cultivate expertise in the areas of Microbial Biotechnology, Health Biotechnology, Environmental Biotechnology, Food and Agricultural Biotechnology, and related allied disciplines, fostering the creation of novel knowledge and advancements in the realm of Biotechnology. Outcomes: After completing the MPhil Biotechnology degree, students will be able to: Recognize the cutting-edge literature in the field of Biotechnology while understanding the theoretical and practical underpinnings of his/her work and indicate how the research may be able to contribute to it. Discover job opportunities in the biotechnology industry in the sectors of academics, research and diagnostic labs, dairy, food, agricultural, poultry, livestock, waste management, and environmental protection agencies, both locally and abroad. Demonstrate their research findings through seminar presentations, sharing their work with fellow students and faculty members during scholarly gatherings in the field of Biotechnology. Gain practical expertise in utilizing statistical, computing, and other relevant techniques for effectively collecting and analyzing research data in the field of Biotechnology. Mass Communication Chairperson’s Message – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Mass Communication Chairperson’s Message LGU 2025-10-10T13:15:03+00:00 Chairperson’s Message Welcome to the Department of Mass Communication at Lahore Garrison University, where we are committed to shaping the future of media and communication in a rapidly evolving digital world. Our vision is to lead in creating media professionals equipped with the skills and knowledge to thrive in today’s dynamic, tech-driven communication landscape. We believe in fostering innovation, creativity, and critical thinking in our students, preparing them to become trailblazers in their respective fields. Through our mission, we strive to offer cutting-edge education and hands-on training that bridges the gap between theory and practice. Our programs focus on developing expertise in media production, digital storytelling, strategic communication, and technological innovation, empowering graduates to excel in diverse areas of the media and communication industry. Our state-of-the-art broadcasting house, equipped with advanced radio and TV production facilities, reflects our commitment to providing students with real-world experiences that align with industry demands. As a department, we are dedicated to nurturing talent and inspiring future leaders who will not only adapt to the ever-changing media landscape but also redefine it. Join us in this exciting journey of exploration, creativity, and excellence. Together, let’s make an impact in the world of media and communication. Warm regards, Dr. Farrah Ul Momineen Chairperson, Department of Mass Communication Lahore Garrison University Page load link Go to Top

Mass Communication HOD’s Message – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Mass Communication HOD’s Message LGU 2025-10-08T10:52:42+00:00 HOD’s Message Department of Mass Communication LGU, with an outstanding faculty and fully equipped media lab, is aiming to provide students with varied opportunities of this vibrant field of studies. The main focus of this department has been to enable the students for exploring their potentials and to provide them with an insight into the academic and professional dynamics of Mass Communication. The faculty facilitates the process of instilling diversified skills among the students such as, effective speaking, objective thinking, creative journalistic writing, productive media research, optimum usage of digital technologies and professional utilization of broadcast equipment. The aspiring mass media professionals are trained to excel and enhance their skills for meeting the competitive market’s demands. As media is the fourth pillar of state, it is our main objective to polish the students with a thoroughly motivated approach so that they may become better professionals for contributing in the development of Pakistan. Masters of Philosophy in Chemistry – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: Masters of Philosophy in Chemistry LGU 2024-07-22T18:58:16+00:00 Masters of Philosophy in Chemistry Program Vision Produce creative and innovative postgraduates in the field of Chemistry who become instrumental in upholding its international standards. Program Mission To contribute in technical and socio-economic development through research based quality education, targeting excellence in basic and applied research while fully engaging them on professional skills. Program Objectives To impart postgraduate students with a conceptual understanding of the basic and Advanced level Chemistry. To develop the capability of analyzing, addressing and posing solutions to problems related to applied research. To enhance student competence in the design and conduct of experiments and analysis and presentation of experimental data and results. To equip students with the necessary skills set for pursuing careers in Chemistry education, research and industry. Program Learning Outcomes After the completion of M.Phil. Chemistry degree, students will be able to: Appreciate the theoretical and experimental skills making them capable of designing, predicting, modeling and analyzing the behavior of Chemical processes. Spirit of working individually as well as in interactive groups with the necessary requirements of scientific and professional ethics. Grasp hands on experience and scientific communication skills to clearly present their research work. Play role at national level in the increase of higher education standards and can positively fulfill the needs in the industry Basic Eligibility Requirements for Admission: Admission is purely merit-based and rests solely on the following criteria: Submission of Complete Application Academic Record Performance in admission test Application Review Interview Performance (if shortlisted) Application processing fee Supporting documents by the stipulated deadline Admission/eligibility criteria Admission to M.Phil. Chemistry Program required 1:Basic Academic Qualification : BS Chemistry (Sixteen years of schooling or 4-year education with minimum 120 credit hours) after F.Sc/Grade 12 shall be required for admission in the M.Phil. Chemistry Program. 2: Admission Test : a) A rigorous University admission test as an eligibility condition for admission to M.Phil. Chemistry program with a passing score of 50%. OR b) Accept the GRE/HAT General/Equivalent tests, with a passing score of 50%. Design research projects/thesis by employing their critical analytical skills in order to meet modern world needs. Course Duration Minimum duration of MPhil English Literature program (24+6=30) is 02 years and maximum three years. MS Data Science Overview – Lahore Garrison University Skip to content Search for: MS Data Science Overview LGU 2025-01-13T18:50:12+00:00 Programme overview and scope: MS degree programme in Data science will provide students the comprehensive skills and knowledge they need to pursue the best career option in one of the most dynamic areas of modern technology. The program will prepare students with broad scientific knowledge, an aptitude in a variety of mathematical and statistical techniques and the ability to synthesize. The main aim of the program is to provide students with the options to be part of a data science endeavour that begins with the identification of business processes, determination of data provenance and ownership, understanding the ecosystem of the business decisions, skill sets and tools that shape the data, making data amenable to analytics, identifying sub-problems, recognizing the technology matrix required for problem resolution, creating incrementally-complex data-driven models and then maintaining them to ultimately leverage them for business growth. Programme Objectives: The main objectives of the MSDS degree programme are: ⦁ To equip students with an in-depth understanding of core and advanced concepts in data science, including data engineering, machine learning, statistical modeling, and big data technologies. ⦁ To develop students’ ability to think critically and analytically, enabling them to design and implement data-driven solutions that address complex organizational and societal challenges. ⦁ To train students in the application of advanced computational, statistical, and machine learning methodologies to extract meaningful insights from diverse and large-scale datasets. ⦁ To produce professionals capable of meeting the growing demand for data science expertise in national and international markets, across industries such as finance, healthcare, and technology. ⦁ To encourage students to engage in innovative research and prepare for advanced studies, enabling contributions to cutting-edge developments in data science and related fields. Learning Outcomes: After the completion of degree students will be able: ⦁ Comprehensive Knowledge: To demonstrate a deep understanding of specialized areas in data science, including machine learning, big data analytics, and statistical modeling, fostering a broad perspective on the field’s potential applications and impact. ⦁ Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: To exhibit strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex, data-driven challenges, applying innovative and evidence-based approaches to real-world scenarios. ⦁ Practical Application: To apply advanced data science tools, techniques, and methodologies to develop solutions that address critical societal and industrial needs, delivering strategic value. ⦁ Research Excellence: To conduct impactful research in challenging areas of data science, contributing novel insights, methodologies, and advancements to the field’s body of knowledge. ⦁ Academic Readiness: To demonstrate readiness for advanced studies, including doctoral programs, in data science and allied disciplines, at globally renowned institutions.
